newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms proposes expanded traking stock.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms proposes expanded traking stock.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said Tuesday that it has filed a preliminary proxy statement for its annual meeting with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commisssion that includes a proposal to expand the scope of its previously authorized Telephony Group tracing stock.

The company said the expanded group, renamed TCI Ventures Group, would consist of the company's interest in Teleport Communications Group Inc, Sprint Spectrum LLP, At home Corp, Tele-Communications International Inc and United Video Satellite Group Inc, as well as all of the company's other domestic non-cable, non-programmng assets.

Tele-Communications said that the TCI VEntures Group stock may be issued through an exchange offer whereby shareholders will have the opportunity to exchange their Series A and Series B TCI Group common stock for corresponding shares of TCI Ventrues Group common stock.
